offline_model.method: Assign a distinct hypothetical numeric thread_id to every (node, thread name) pair in the frozen healthy trace, then evaluate the pinned OccurrenceGraph with reject_coarse_roots=true. These IDs are a feasibility model, not runtime evidence.

structural_reason: The line-405 door and line-205 check are events in one startNewSubprocedure region occurrence. Core 439 accepts their ordered, same-thread direct path with an empty edge tuple, but event_path(require_edge=true) requires at least one observed edge. Its nested program-order rule only adds an edge into a direct child region, not between two events in this same region.
agent_status: The staged 5a agent omits numeric thread_id. Available immutable agent JARs inspected locally also omit it. The current Probe.java source contains numeric thread_id emission, but staging an agent from that source alone cannot make this same-region path a nonempty observed graph path.

admission.required_change: A separately reviewed sound graph rule for a same-region dataflow/program-order path, or a documented strict criterion for a direct same-region event-time witness, before another healthy run can test strict admission.
